svg.title: The minimizer for 11 points: an edge-contracted icosahedron
svg.desc: Eleven points on the unit sphere, rotating about their axis of symmetry: one point on the axis, three pairs of points in the two mirror planes, and four points that are the corners of a rectangle. Its Coulomb energy 40.596 is the minimum for 11 points.

g.text: Three pairs in the two mirror planes
